title: A goal figure names the run it was measured on, and the planning premise measures it that way
goal: Sprint planning (/kb-sprint plan step 6 and kb/_self/backlog.md, Sprints) states that a goal's time or share figure names the run it was measured on (profiled or not, which host, warm or cold) and that the premise measures the same run, so the done check compares like with like; SP-yzgetyu2: ST-s6tqojsw's 'about a third of today's 6.3 s' took a cProfile baseline while the work was timed unprofiled (3.97 s to 2.2 s), and the review found the goal unmet by its own words (accepted at the SP-yzgetyu2 close)
